guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設：環形堰頂自由流；Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s
教學假設：喉部孔口控制；Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s
教學假設：豎井通水與空芯；shaftDiameter=5 m; airCoreDiameter=3 m; liquidArea=pi*(5**2-3**2)/4=12.5664 m2
教學假設：通氣需求與管徑；AirVolumeAtLocalConditions=15 m3/s; meanAirVelocity=12 m/s; requiredFlowArea=15/12=1.25 m2
教學假設：旋渦環流與水頭；Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s
教學假設：豎井底彎轉動量；rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=60 m3/s; V=10 m/s; rightAngleMomentumMagnitude=sqrt(2)*1000*60*10/1000=848.528 kN

Teaching assumption: Throat orifice control; Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s
Teaching assumption: Shaft water area and air core; shaftDiameter=5 m; airCoreDiameter=3 m; liquidArea=pi*(5**2-3**2)/4=12.5664 m2

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：豎井式溢洪道
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Shaft spillways
guides.concept: 本課以辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換為主線，先用環形堰頂自由流與喉部孔口控制界定水力與構造條件，再將旋渦環流與水頭、下游管流摩阻連結到瞬變量測與取樣。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions through Circular crest free flow and Throat orifice control, then connects Swirl circulation and head and Downstream conduit friction to Transient measurement and sampling. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
procedure: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。水頭增加後控制可能移往喉部與隧道，應避免以同一冪次延伸整條率定曲線。 驗證時應沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
喉部淹沒後可能由有效孔口面積與水頭差控制流量，流量對水頭的反應比自由堰流緩。排氣、下游壓力與流量係數都會影響此關係；孔口公式並不描述控制轉換期間的劇烈波動，需以連續升降流量試驗辨認。 驗證時應在升流與降流過程比較喉部壓力和水位流量曲線，並辨識以下失效情境：控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
豎井中沿壁水膜與中央空氣芯可能並存，水量連續應只用液相過水面積。簡化環狀截面忽略含氣與非均勻流速，仍可提醒學生不能將整個井徑都算成水流面積；空芯縮小也會改變通氣和壓力邊界。 驗證時應以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量，並辨識以下失效情境：空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
水流捲帶空氣進入下游通道，補氣不足會造成低壓與不穩定振盪。給定空氣體積流量與允許平均速度可作截面盤點，不能代替可壓縮流與入口損失分析；空氣體積需標明當地壓力溫度，否則密度與流量不可比。 驗證時應同步記錄通氣管空氣流量與井內絕對壓力，並辨識以下失效情境：鳥網或雜物堵塞會增加通氣阻力並放大負壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。 驗證時應以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
落水在井底彎轉為水平流時，方向改變形成明顯作用力，壓力與速度沿彎道分布不均。簡化等速直角轉彎的向量差只計動量項，實際支承作用還含壓力力與水重；不可直接把此單項當成彎道完整設計荷載。 驗證時應以彎道壓力積分及入口出口速度向量核對受力方向，並辨識以下失效情境：漏列壓力力會使支承反力估算不完整。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
當下游通道滿流時，沿程摩阻消耗水頭並可能回控豎井容量；自由水面流則需不同計算架構。達西摩阻係數與管長徑比必須配套使用，接頭、彎道與出入口損失另列，不能因管徑大就忽略整段水頭需求。 驗證時應以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，並辨識以下失效情境：在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。 驗證時應用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
鐘口附近漂流物可形成環狀或偏心堵塞，既減少有效入口又引入不對稱旋流。單純面積減量只作幾何示意，實際洩量還受堆積形狀與通氣影響；試驗需涵蓋不同漂流物位置以及清除前後的水位反應。 驗證時應以多種堵塞布置觀察偏流旋渦與通氣壓力變化，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心堵塞可能同時削弱洩量與補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
控制轉換伴隨的壓力振盪可能比水位平均變化快，量測系統需足夠採樣率並處理抗混疊。奈奎斯特條件只是避免理想頻率折疊的最低要求，不代表波形與尖峰已被精確重建；需根據實際頻帶與感測器響應安排記錄。 驗證時應以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應，並辨識以下失效情境：未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
procedureEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity. An illustrative coefficient cannot transfer across geometries, and higher heads may move control to the throat or tunnel rather than preserve one power law. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Once submerged, the throat may act as an orifice governed by effective area and head difference. Discharge then responds less strongly to head than free-weir flow. Venting, downstream pressure and coefficient matter, and the equation does not describe unstable transitions between these regimes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare throat pressure and stage-discharge curves during increasing and decreasing flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

A wall-attached water layer can surround an air core. Liquid continuity therefore uses the water area rather than the full shaft. A simple annulus omits aeration and velocity variation but shows why air-core changes affect both mean liquid speed and the ventilation boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use imaging or air probes to establish air-core size and check liquid discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Air-core contraction can turn open ventilation into restricted flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Entrained air must be replaced through ventilation paths; insufficient supply can cause low pressure and oscillation. Area from specified air volume and speed is only a continuity check, not compressible-flow or inlet-loss analysis. State local pressure and temperature when reporting air volume to preserve comparability. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record vent airflow and shaft absolute pressure simultaneously. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Screens or debris blockage increases ventilation resistance and deepens subpressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity. A free-vortex model applies only outside a specified core and cannot be extrapolated to infinite center velocity; test antivortex devices for both flow guidance and obstruction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

At the shaft bottom, flow turns from vertical to horizontal and generates substantial reaction. An equal-speed right-angle vector difference estimates only momentum change. Real support loads also include pressure forces and water weight, so that single component is not the complete bend design load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check force direction using bend-pressure integration and inlet-outlet velocity vectors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting pressure forces leaves the support-reaction estimate incomplete. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

A full downstream conduit loses head to friction and may control shaft capacity; free-surface operation needs another framework. Use Darcy friction factor consistently with length-to-diameter ratio and list local losses separately. A large diameter does not eliminate the head demand along a long conduit. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation. A constant-area short-interval estimate illustrates imbalance but omits changing storage geometry and time-dependent outflow; one static rating point cannot route a flood. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Debris around a bellmouth can block the inlet asymmetrically and induce swirl. An area deduction describes geometry only; discharge also depends on accumulation shape and ventilation. Test different positions and examine stage response before and after removal instead of equating blockage area with discharge loss. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Observe asymmetric flow, vortices and ventilation pressures for several blockage layouts. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric blockage may reduce both discharge and ventilation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

Pressure oscillations during control transitions may be faster than mean stage changes. Sampling and anti-alias filtering must cover the relevant band. Nyquist is a minimum ideal condition, not a guarantee of accurate waveform or peak reconstruction; account for the sensor response and observed frequency content. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
evidence: 交接時以沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以在升流與降流過程比較喉部壓力和水位流量曲線作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以同步記錄通氣管空氣流量與井內絕對壓力作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對鳥網或雜物堵塞會增加通氣阻力並放大負壓，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
交接時以以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
evidenceEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare throat pressure and stage-discharge curves during increasing and decreasing flow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use imaging or air probes to establish air-core size and check liquid discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Air-core contraction can turn open ventilation into restricted flow. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record vent airflow and shaft absolute pressure simultaneously. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Screens or debris blockage increases ventilation resistance and deepens subpressure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
pitfalls: 偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動。診斷時應採取以下查核：以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。診斷時應採取以下查核：以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。診斷時應採取以下查核：以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
偏心堵塞可能同時削弱洩量與補氣。診斷時應採取以下查核：以多種堵塞布置觀察偏流旋渦與通氣壓力變化，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
pitfallsEn: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Air-core contraction can turn open ventilation into restricted flow. Diagnose it by the following check: Use imaging or air probes to establish air-core size and check liquid discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. Diagnose it by the following check: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Diagnose it by the following check: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

Eccentric blockage may reduce both discharge and ventilation. Diagnose it by the following check: Observe asymmetric flow, vortices and ventilation pressures for several blockage layouts. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 溢洪道氣蝕防治
related.transfer: 可遷移「環形堰頂自由流」與「下游管流摩阻」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；溢洪道氣蝕防治的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Circular crest free flow" and "Downstream conduit friction" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cavitation mitigation in spillways must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換；溢洪道氣蝕防治則以由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions; Cavitation mitigation in spillways centres on verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「環形堰頂自由流」與「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到溢洪道氣蝕防治，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「拋離空腔與再附著」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Circular crest free flow” and “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cavitation mitigation in spillways, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Jet cavity and reattachment", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 豎井式溢洪道
history.text: 本課所研究的辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
